notRunCases.name: CSV download and selected-row CSV content
steps: Select five current-page rows in the advanced grid. Export selected and save inside a dedicated test output directory.
Parse selected-customers.csv and assert exactly five data records, the six expected columns, matching selected customer IDs and valid escaping.
Download all-customer CSV and verify its records against the current REST customer state.
notRunCases.expected: Downloaded bytes parse correctly and correspond to the selected/all current records.
notRunCases.reason: The MCP 0.5.0 typed actions do not expose a browser download-event capture/save-path action. Native JSON export bytes were independently verified.

notRunCases.name: Physical task drag-and-drop gesture
steps: Create a synthetic task in To do.
Physically drag its card to Done using observed UI coordinates.
Read REST state and assert the same task ID now has lane Done.
Reload the board and confirm the card remains in Done.
notRunCases.expected: The gesture updates persistent state. Keyboard alternative is already covered by SUP02.
notRunCases.reason: The MCP 0.5.0 typed UI action schema has no drag action. The accessible keyboard alternative passed.

notRunCases.name: Audible playback and canvas pixel changes
steps: Play, pause and seek the local audio sample and observe actual audible output/playback time.
Capture canvas pixels before and after Change canvas signal and inspect the signal rendering.
notRunCases.expected: The local audio plays and controls work; the canvas visual changes consistently with its accessible signal level.
notRunCases.reason: SUP03 verified the audio asset, canvas equivalent action, progress and meter. It did not assert audible output or compare pixels; no visual baseline was created.

notRunCases.name: Rich text bold and italic formatting
steps: Enter synthetic release notes. Select a text range and apply Bold selected text and Italic selected text.
Verify the selected characters visibly use the expected formatting and that other characters remain unchanged.
Submit a valid project and verify the resulting release-note text.
notRunCases.expected: Formatting applies to the selected range and the textual result remains correct.
notRunCases.reason: SUP04 verified contenteditable input and submitted text. Character-range formatting was not exercised by the typed MCP suite.
